name: Braiding Your Hair
overview: Scripture teaches clear distinctions in gender roles and appearances, as seen in Deuteronomy 22:5, which forbids women from adopting male attire and vice versa, labeling such actions as abominations to the LORD. While the other verses, John 3:16 and Revelation 1:1, emphasize God's love through Christ and the divine revelation given to His servants, the principle of honoring God's design in our outward presentation, including practices like braiding hair, aligns with living in obedience to His commands and reflecting His glory.
